ka-hgis portable (no OSGeo4W install on the target PC)

Copy this whole folder to another Windows 10/11 x64 PC (USB or share).
No C:\OSGeo4W and no Visual Studio required.

Run:
  start.bat
  or ka-hgis.exe
  or run.bat
